entries.subject: Per-channel maps from the 349 spectroscopic phase curves
entries.finding: Evans-Soma et al. (2025) fit a starry dipole to each spectroscopic channel, but the deposit holds the phase-binned ratios and temperatures, not each channel's map coefficients. Refitting maps to them would be our own fit, second to the paper's values.
entries.revisitWhen: The per-channel amplitudes, Y(1,0) coefficients and offsets are published or deposited.

entries.subject: The MIRI eclipse map of Kahle et al. (submitted)
entries.finding: Kahle et al. (arXiv:2606.21855) report a MIRI/LRS eclipse map with a 4.8 degree eastward hotspot; the paper is submitted and its map is not in the deposit (Zenodo 20767846 holds light curves and spectra).
entries.revisitWhen: The paper is accepted and its map is deposited.

entries.subject: ESPRESSO wind layers (Seidel et al. 2025, Nature)
entries.finding: The measured winds at three heights, including an iron and sodium jet stream, are velocities along the terminator, not a surface map; a sphere cannot show them without a renderer extension.
entries.revisitWhen: The renderer can draw atmospheric flow over a planet.

entries.subject: The tidally stretched shape of WASP-121b
entries.finding: The planet is expected to be stretched toward its star; Mikal-Evans et al. (2023) tried an oblate shape in their fits and found it changed nothing, and no shape is measured. It is drawn as a sphere.
entries.revisitWhen: A fit measures its ellipsoidal shape.
